messages:
toni: Opening a tiny quickstart refresh PR to trim the hello-world to a single-file example and harmonize auth across Node/Python/Go. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/487. Can someone from devex skim?

rahul: Happy to. Main ask: replace old env names with RW_API_KEY everywhere and add a one-line note about region hosts.

toni: yes, will do. Also adding a minimal Docker section: build + run with RW_API_KEY passed as env.

devx-bot: Reminder: include a non-SDK curl example for fast smoke tests.

sara: I'll fix the Go snippet to use redwood.New(cfg) and Generate(ctx, opts). Also adding a short migration table mapping legacy envs to RW_* ones.

rahul: small nit: update the quickstart to mention Console -> Settings -> API Tokens so users know where to copy keys from.

toni: added that. Also fixed a broken internal link to /docs/auth (it moved during nav changes). Filed redirect and updated link in the PR.

sara: pushed Go + Python snippet fixes. Kept the curl example first per the bot.

rahul: CI suggestion: add an opt-in snippet-lint job that checks syntax only (node --check, python -m py_compile, go vet). No network calls.

toni: great idea. I'll add it as an optional workflow that runs when the secret SNIPPET_CI is set. Merge after CI green.

sara: Preview build up: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/pr-487. Quick visual pass looks good.

toni: thanks team ":thumbsup:" will merge when green and post a short note in #onboarding about the env rename.
